title: Slow Cooker Adobo Chicken with Bok Choy
description: This is a slow cooker version of a classic dish from the Philippines using chicken thighs, bok choy, apple cider vinegar, onion, and garlic.
ingredients: 1 large head bok choy, cut into 1-inch strips

steps.text: Combine onions, garlic, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, and bay leaf in slow cooker. Season with black pepper. Place chicken thighs atop mixture. Sprinkle paprika over chicken thighs.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours.
Switch slow cooker to High. Add bok choy to chicken mixture; cook another 5 minutes. Garnish with green onion.

video.description: Put everything in the slow cooker before you head to work, and come home to wonderfully tender, extremely flavorful adobo chicken. Begin by filling your slow cooker with onions, garlic, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar and a bay leaf. Add some fresh black pepper and place chicken thighs on top. Sprinkle paprika over everything, cover and cook low, then when you arrive home, switch the temperature to high, add bok choy and cook until they’re done. Then garnish with green onion and serve with rice. The entire family will go crazy-hungry for this delicious tangy and juicy chicken dinner!
